arabic_text: فَاعْطِنِي يَا رَبِّ مَا رَجَوْتُ، وَآمِنِّي مَا حَذِرْتُ، وَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِعَائِدَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ الْمَسْؤُولِينَ.
transliteration: faʿṭinī yā rabbi mā rajawtu wa āminnī mā ḥaḏirtu waʿud ʿalayya biʿā'idati raḥmatika innaka akramu al-mas'ūlīn
english_text: So give me, my Lord, what I hope for, make me secure against what frightens me, and act kindly toward me with the kindly act of mercy! Surely Thou art the most generous of those from whom are asked!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإذْ سَتَـرْتَنِي بِعَفْوِكَ وَتَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ فِي دَارِ الْفَنَاءِ بِحَضرَةِ الأكْفَاءِ فَأَجِرْنِي مِنْ فَضِيحَاتِ دَارِ الْبَقَاءِ عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الأشْهَادِ مِنَ المَلائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
transliteration: allāhumma wa-idh satar­tanī bi-ʿafwik wa-taghammad­tanī bi-faḍlik fī dār al-fanāʾ bi-ḥaḍrat al-akfāʾi faajirnii min fadiihati daaril baqaa'ِ ʿinda mawāqifi al-ashhād min al-malā'ikati al-muqarrabīn
english_text: O God, since Thou hast covered me with Thy pardon and shielded me with Thy bounty in the abode of annihilation and the presence of equals grant me sanctuary from the disgraces of the Abode of Subsistence at the standing places of the Witnesses (the angels brought nigh,

arabic_text: وَالرُّسُلِ الْمُكَرَّمِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، مِنْ جَار كُنْتُ أُكَاتِمُهُ سَيِّئاتِي وَمِنْ ذِي رَحِم كُنْتُ أَحْتَشِمُ مِنْهُ فِي سَرِيرَاتِي،
transliteration: wa al-rusuli al-mukarramīna wa al-shuhadā'i wa al-ṣāliḥīn min jār kuntu ukātimuhu sayyi'ātī wa min dhī raḥim kuntu aḥtashimu minhu fī sarīrātī
english_text: the messengers honoured, the martyrs, the righteous) before the neighbour from whom I have hidden my evil deeds and the womb relative before whom I feel ashamed in my secret thoughts!

arabic_text: لَمْ أَثِقْ بِهِمْ رَبِّ فِي السِّتْرِ عَلَيَّ، وَوَثِقْتُ بِكَ رَبِّ فِي الْمَغفِرَةِ لِيْ،
transliteration: lam athiq bihim rabbī fī as-sitr ʿalayya wa wathiqtu bika rabbī fil-maghfirati lī
english_text: I trust them not, my Lord, to cover me over, but I trust Thee, my Lord, to forgive me!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ أوْلَى مَنْ وُثِقَ بِهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ وَأَرْأَفُ مَنِ اسْتُرْحِمَ فَارْحَمْنِي.
transliteration: wa-anta awla man wuthiqa bihi wa-a'ta man rughiba ilayh wa-arʾafu mani sturhimah farḥamni
english_text: Thou art the most worthy of those in whom confidence is had, the most giving of those who are besought, and the most clement of those from whom mercy is asked. So have mercy upon me!

arabic_text: أللهُمَّ وَأنتَ حَدَرْتَنِي مَاءً مَهِيناً مِنْ صُلب، مُتَضَائِقِ الْعِظَامِ حَرِجِ الْمَسَالِكِ إلَى رَحِم ضَيِّقَة سَتَرْتَهَا بِالْحُجُبِ
transliteration: allāhumma wa anta ḥadar tanī mā’an mahīnan min ṣulbi mutada'iq al-'izam harji al-masalik 'ila raḥim ḍayyiqaḥ satarthā bil-ḥujub
english_text: O God, Thou caused me to descend as mean water from loins of narrow bones and tight passages into a constricted womb which Thou hadst covered with veils;

arabic_text: تُصَرِّفُنِي حَالاًَ عَنْ حَال حَتَّى انْتَهَيْتَ بِيْ إلَى تَمَامِ الصُّورَةِ وَأَثْبَتَّ فِيَّ الْجَوَارحَ كَمَا نَعَتَّ فِي كِتَابِكَ نُطْفَةً ثُمَّ عَلَقَةً ثُمَّ مُضْغَةً ثُمَّ عِظَاماً
transliteration: tuṣarrifunī ḥālan ʿan ḥāl ḥattā antaḥayta bī ilā tamāmi al-ṣūrah wa'athbat fiyyal jawarih kamā naʿatta fī kitābika nuṭfatan thumma ʿalaqatan thumma muḍghatan thumma ʿiẓaman
english_text: Thou turned me about from state to state until Thou tookest me to the completion of the form and fixed within me the bodily parts, as Thou hast described in Thy Book: a drop, then a clot, then a tissue, then bones,

arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَسَوْتَ الْعِظَامَ لَحْماً ثُمَّ أَنْشَأتَنِي خَلْقَاً آخَرَ كَمَا شِئْتَ،
transliteration: thumma kasawta al-'izama lahman, thumma ansha'tanee khalqan akhara kama shi'ta
english_text: then Thou garmented the bones with flesh, then Thou produced me as another creature as Thou willed (ref.23:12-14).

arabic_text: حَتَّى إذَا احْتَجْتُ إلَى رِزْقِكَ، وَلَمْ أَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ غِيَـاثِ فَضْلِكَ جَعَلْتَ لِي قُـوتـاً مِنْ فَضْلِ طَعَام وَشَرَاب أَجْرَيْتَهُ لاِمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ أَسْكَنْتَنِي جَوْفَهَا وَأَوْدَعْتَنِي قَرَارَ رَحِمِهَا،
transliteration: ḥattā ʾiḏa iḥtajtu ʾilā rizqika walam astaghni 'an ghīāthi faḍlika jaʿalta ly quwwatan min faḍl ṭaʿām wa sharāb ajrāytahu lāimatikal-latī askanitanī jawfahā waawdaʿtanī qarāra raḥimihā
english_text: Then, when I needed Thy provision, and could not do without the aid of Thy bounty, Thou appointed for me a nourishment from the bounty of the food and drink which Thou bestowed upon Thy handmaid in whose belly Thou gavest me to rest and in the lodging of whose womb Thou deposited me.

arabic_text: وَلَوْ تَكِلُنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَـالاتِ إلَى حَوْلِي، أَوْ تَضْطَرُّنِي إلَى قُوّتي لَكَانَ الْحَوْلُ عَنِّي مُعْتَزِلاً، وَلَكَانَتِ الْقُوَّةُ مِنِّي بَعِيدَةً،
transliteration: wa-law takilunī yā rabbī fī tilka al-ḥālāt ilá ḥawlī aw taḍṭarrunī ilā qūwati lakāna al-ḥawlu ʿannī muʿtazilān, wa lakānatil-quwwatu minnī baʿīdah
english_text: Hadst Thou entrusted me in those states, my Lord, to my own force or driven me to have recourse to my own strength, force would have been removed from me and strength taken far away.

arabic_text: فَغَذَوْتَنِي بِفَضْلِكَ غِذَاءَ البَرِّ اللَّطِيفِ ،
transliteration: faghadhawtani bifaḍlika ghiẓā'a al-barri al-laṭhīf
english_text: So Thou hast fed me through Thy bounty with the food of the Good, the Gentle;

arabic_text: تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ بِي تَطَوُّلاً عَلَيَّ إلَى غَايَتِي هَذِهِ،
transliteration: tafʿalu dhālika bī taṭawwulan ʿalayya ilā ghāyatī hadhihi
english_text: Thou hast done that for me in graciousness toward me up to this my present point.

arabic_text: لاَ أَعْدَمُ بِرَّكَ وَلاَ يُبْطِئُ بِي حُسْنُ صَنِيعِكَ،
transliteration: lā ʾaʿdamu birraka walā yubṭiʾu bī ḥusnu ṣanīʿika
english_text: I do not lack Thy goodness nor does Thy benefaction keep me waiting.

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَتَأكَّدُ مَعَ ذَلِكَ ثِقَتِي، فَأَتَفَرَّغَ لِمَا هُوَ أَحْظَى لِيْ عِنْدَكَ،
transliteration: walā tataʾakkadu maʿa dhālika thiqa'tī fa'atafarraġa limā huwa aḥẓā lī 'indaka
english_text: Yet with all that, my trust has not become firm enough that I might free myself for that which is more favoured by Thee.

arabic_text: قَدْ مَلَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ عِنَانِي فِي سُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَضَعْفِ الْيَقِينِ،
transliteration: qad malaka al-shayṭān ʿinānī fī sūʾi al-ẓanni wa ḍaʿfi al-yaqīn
english_text: Satan has taken possession of my reins through my distrust and frail certainty.

arabic_text: فَأَنَا أَشْكُو سُوْءَ مُجَاوَرَتِهِ لِي وَطَـاعَةَ نَفْسِي لَـهُ،
transliteration: fa ana ashku suu' mujaawaratihi li wa ta'ata nafsi lahu
english_text: I complain of his evil neighbourhood with me and my soul's obedience toward him!

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَعْصِمُـكَ مِنْ مَلَكَتِهِ، وَأَتَضَـرَّعُ إلَيْكَ في صَرفِ كَيدِهِ عَنّي
transliteration: wa-astaʿsimuka min malakatihi, wa-ataḍarracu ilayka fi ṣarfi kaydihi ʿanni
english_text: I ask Thee to preserve me against his domination, and I plead with Thee to turn his trickery away from me!

arabic_text: و أسأَلُكَ فِي أَنْ تُسَهِّلَ إلَى رِزْقِي سَبِيلاً، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ابْتِدَائِكَ بِالنِّعَمِ الْجِسَامِ، وَإلْهَامِكَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى الإحْسَانِ وَالإِنْعَامِ ،
transliteration: wa as'aluka fi an tusahhila ila rizqi sabilaً falaka al-ḥamdu ʿalā ibtidāʾika bin-naʿami al-jisāmi wa'ilhāmika ash-shukra 'alā al-iḥsāni wal-in'ām
english_text: I ask Thee to make the path to my provision easy, since to Thee belongs praise for Thy beginning with immense favours and Thy inspiring gratitude for beneficence and bestowing favour!

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَسَهِّلْ عَلَيَّ رِزْقِي وَأَنْ تُقَنِّعَنِي بِتَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ ، وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَنِي بِحِصَّتِيْ فِيمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَـلَ مَـا ذَهَبَ مِنْ جِسْمِيْ وَعُمُرِيْ
transliteration: fasalli ʿala muḥammad wa ālihi wasahhil ʿalayya rizqī wa-an tuqanniʿanī bi-taqdīrikalī. wa ʾan turḍiyani bi-ḥiṣṣatī fīmā qasamta lī wa-an tajʿala ma dhahaba min jismi wa ʿumuri
english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household, and make the way to my provision easy for me! [I ask Thee] to make me content with Thy ordainment for me, to make me satisfied with my lot in that which Thou hast apportioned for me and to place what has gone of my body and my life-span

arabic_text: فِي سَبِيْلِ طَاعَتِكَ إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ.
transliteration: fī sabīli ṭāʿatika innaka khayru al-rāziqīn
english_text: into the path of Thy obedience! Surely Thou art the Best of providers!

arabic_text: أللَهُمَّ إنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مَنْ نَارٍ تَغَلَّظْتَ بِهَا عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَتَوَعَّدْتَ بِهَا مَنْ صَدَفَ عَنْ رِضَاكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika man nār taghallaẓta bihā ʿalā man ʿaṣāka wa tawa'addta bihā man ṣadafa 'an riḍāk
english_text: O God, I seek refuge in Thee from the Fire through which Thou art harsh toward him who disobeys Thee and by which Thou hast threatened him who turns away from Thy good pleasure;

arabic_text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ نورُهَا ظُلْمَة وَهَيِّنُهَا أَلِيمٌ، وَبَعِيدُهَا قَرِيبٌ،
transliteration: wa min naarin nooruhaa zulmataw wa hayyinuhaa aleemun, wa baeeduhaa qareebun
english_text: from the Fire whose light is darkness, whose ease is pain, and whose far is near;

arabic_text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ يَأْكُلُ بَعْضَهَا بَعْضٌ، وَيَصُولُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْض،
transliteration: wa min narin ya'kulu baʿduha baʿdun wa yaṣūlu baʿḍuhā ʿalā baʿḍ
english_text: from the Fire parts of which devour parts and parts of which leap upon parts;

arabic_text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ تَذَرُ الْعِظَامَ رَمِيماً، وَتَسْقِي أَهْلَهَا حَمِيماً ،
transliteration: wa min nārin taḏaru al-ʿiẓāma ramīmāً wa tasqī ahlahā ḥamīmān
english_text: from the Fire which leaves bones decayed and lets its people drink boiling water;

arabic_text: وَمِنْ نَارٍ لاَ تُبْقِي عَلَى مَنْ تَضَرَّعَ إلَيْهَا، وَلاَ تَرْحَمُ مَنِ اسْتَعْطَفَهَا، وَلاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى التَّخْفِيفِ عَمَّنْ خَشَعَ لَهَا وَاسْتَسْلَمَ إلَيْهَا،
transliteration: wa min naarin laa tubqee ʿalaa man taḍarraʿa ilayha wa lā tarḥamu mani istaʿṭafahā walā taqdīru ʿalā at-takhfīfi ʿammān khashaʿa lahā wastaslama ilayhā
english_text: from the Fire which 'does not spare him who pleads to it,' has no mercy on him who seeks sympathy from it, and has no power to relieve him who humbles himself before it and yields himself to it;

arabic_text: تَلْقَى سُكَّانَهَا بِأَحَرِّ مَا لَدَيْهَا مِنْ أَلِيْمِ النَّكَالِ وَشَدِيدِ الْوَبَالِ،
transliteration: talqā sukkanahā bi'aḥarri mā ladayhā min ʾalīmi ʾn-nakāli wa shadīdi l-wabāli
english_text: it meets its inhabitants with the hottest that it possesses: painful punishment and intense noxiousness.

arabic_text: وَأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْ عَقَارِبِهَا الْفَاغِرَةِ أَفْوَاهُهَا، وَحَيّاتِهَا الصَّالِقَةِ بِأَنْيَابِهَا، وَشَرَابِهَا الَّذِي يُقَطِّعُ أَمْعَاءَ وَأَفْئِدَةَ سُكَّانِهَا، وَيَنْزِعُ قُلُوبَهُمْ،
transliteration: wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿaqāribiha al-fāghirati afwāhuhā waḥayyātihā al-ṣāliqati bi'anyābihā wa sharābihā alladhī yuqattiu ʾamaʿāʾa wa ʾafʾidat sukkanihā, wa yanziʿu qulūbahum
english_text: seek refuge in Thee from its gaping-jawed scorpions, its scraping-toothed serpents, and its drinks, which tear apart the intestines and hearts of its inhabitants and root out their marrows.

arabic_text: وَأَسْتَهْدِيْكَ لِمَا باعَدَ مِنْهَا وَأَخَّرَ عَنْهَا.
transliteration: wa astahdīka limā bāʿada minhā wa akhkhara ʿanhā
english_text: I ask guidance from Thee to that which will keep far from it and make it retreat!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْهَا بِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَقِلْنِي عَثَرَاتِي بِحُسْنِ إقَالَتِكَ ، وَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي يَا خَيْرَ الْمُجيرِينَ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-ajirnī minhā bifadl raḥmatika wa-aqilni ʿatharati bi-ḥusni iqālatika walā takhdhulnī yā khayral mujiyreen
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, grant me sanctuary from it through the bounty of Thy mercy, release me from my stumbles through Thy good releasing, and abandon me not, O Best of the sanctuary-granters!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ تَقِي الْكَرِيهَةَ ، وَتُعْطِي الْحَسَنَةَ ، وَتَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيـدُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
transliteration: allāhumma innaka taqī al-karīhata, wa tuʿtī al-ḥasanah wa tafʿalu ma turīdu wa anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
english_text: O God, Thou protectest from the disliked, givest the good, dost what Thou wilt, and Thou art "powerful over everything" (3:26).
